"""P08: hold no-index / 36 m / 60 d every round (supplier sweetens its own clause sheet), answer its volume question."""
import sys, os
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
from plib import hold_policy

CASE = "case:P08"
R1 = ("Dear Mr Aigner,\n\nthank you for your letter of 12 September. We want to settle the price basis for the next "
      "36 months on a fixed price, without a surcharge clause, so both sides can plan.\n\n"
      "Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).\n"
      "Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).\n\n"
      "We commit the full 94,800 kg a year for 36 months, 284,400 kg in total, at EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed, 60 days.\n\n"
      "Kind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
LATER = ("Dear Mr Aigner,\n\nthank you. To your question: we commit 94,800 kg a year, binding for 36 months. We prefer a "
         "fixed price over a surcharge clause and can move to EUR {p:.2f} per kg, fixed, 60 days, 36 months.\n\n"
         "Kind regards\nHollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing")
move = hold_policy(CASE, 4.96, {"index_clause": None, "payment_days": 60, "contract_months": 36}, R1, LATER)

case.title: Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH. Alloy surcharge and base price for 1.4404 bar. Need: 94800 kg a year. Category goal: leverage: competition and data should bring the price down. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 10 days). Fallback if you walk away: the second-source quote quote:7200008. Must-haves: none. Prepare from the data package.

Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our offer for a price of €6.05 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, and no Preisgleitklausel. 

To give you some background on our current situation and market conditions, AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. Furthermore, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. Lastly, PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our partnership with your team and supplying your needs from our extensive inventory.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH

message.subject: Part case:P08 - our proposal
message.body:
Dear Mr Aigner,

thank you for your letter of 12 September. We want to settle the price basis for the next 36 months on a fixed price, without a surcharge clause, so both sides can plan.

Producer prices DE: cold drawing of bars changed -2.3% from 2026-06 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-06, idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08).
Our volume forecast for part:370010 changed by +1.9% (fc:370010@2026-09).

We commit the full 94,800 kg a year for 36 months, 284,400 kg in total, at EUR 4.96 per kg, fixed, 60 days.

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

response.subject: Re: Part case:P08 - our proposal
response.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We appreciate your volume commitment and acknowledge the recent decrease in producer prices, which we have factored into our calculation.

AS-14404 rose 5.9 % in twelve months and is 45 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 5 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C2431 rose 12.3 % in twelve months and is 38 % of our cost. That remains. Our price follows our main cost drivers: AS-14404, PPI-C2431, LCI-C. However, we cannot fix the price for a 36-month period due to raw material volatility. We can accept the 36-month term and 60-day payment terms at a base price of EUR 5.49 per kg, provided we include an AS-14404 surcharge clause. We can offer a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404, AS-14404, AS-14404. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.

For our current Angebot, we present a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months, a Preisgleitklausel on AS-14404. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Georg Aigner
Inside Sales, Edelstahl-Service Donautal GmbH
